connector.name: Gemini Code Context MCP
connector.registryDescription: Gemini 2M context cache for Claude Code - persistent; repeat queries ~8x faster, ~4x cheaper.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gemini-code-context-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the qmediat account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: GEMINI_CREDENTIALS_PROFILE
env.description: Profile name in ~/.config/qmediat/credentials (chmod 0600). Created by `npx @qmediat.io/gemini-code-context-mcp init`. Recommended; keeps your API key out of ~/.claude.json.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Fallback Tier 3 auth. Your Gemini API key. Emits a warning at startup recommending you move it to the credentials profile via the init command.

env.name: GEMINI_USE_VERTEX
env.description: Set to `true` to use Vertex AI backend via Application Default Credentials. Requires GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.

env.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
env.description: GCP project ID when using Vertex AI backend. Only read when GEMINI_USE_VERTEX=true.

env.name: GEMINI_DAILY_BUDGET_USD
env.description: Hard daily USD cap enforced locally. Server refuses calls after the cap until UTC midnight. Unlimited if unset. Honoured by `ask`, `code`, and per-iteration by `ask_agentic`.

env.name: GEMINI_CODE_CONTEXT_DEFAULT_MODEL
env.description: Model alias (`latest-pro`, `latest-pro-thinking`, `latest-flash`, `latest-lite`, `latest-vision`) or literal model ID. Default: `latest-pro`.

env.name: GEMINI_CODE_CONTEXT_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Context Cache TTL in seconds. Default: 3600 (1 hour). Hot workspaces (<10 min since last use) auto-refresh via background watcher.
